messages:
natalie: follow-up from today’s all-hands Q&A  leadership wanted a tight capture of why we20win/lose and concrete customer asks + owners. please drop single-line confirmations and any blockers.

sam: short framing: wins = predictable latency + easy pilots + clear security posture. losses = procurement uncertainty (esp midmarket), long legal timelines for data residency, and worry about hallucinations in high-stakes contexts.

mira: Sales signal: conversion drops at the point of procurement when buyers can27t see per-route cost caps or token line items. wins are almost always tied to a simple ops runbook + measurable perf numbers.

alex: CS adds: top asks we hear repeatedly: 1) VPC/on-prem timeline 2) token-level billing exports (CSV/API) 3) purchasable SLO/latency tiers and an "on-call" pilot SLA 4) reranker + deterministic fallback for hallucination-sensitive flows.

devin: Eng note: runtime improvements (KV cache + adaptive batching) land next sprint; expected p95 improvement ~15-25% on long chats. also prototyping graceful fallback routing that swaps to a quantized variant when latency spikes — PRs under `runtime/fallback`.

tara: Product: planning to propose 3 SLO packages (basic/standard/enterprise) and a midmarket-friendly pricing table (per-route caps + monthly commit tiers). will draft a partner-facing 1-pager.

ben: Research/Optimize: customers in healthcare and fintech ask for certified KMS/HSM integrations and stricter hallucination mitigations. they want reranking + confidence scores surfaced to apps.

jordan: Legal: big blocker for some deals is data residency language and standard indemnities. private/VPC commitments need clear certification milestones to move faster.

ci-bot: action created: TICKET-5234 "AH: wins/losses & customer asks" assigned: natalie, mira, devin, tara.

sam: owners please add 1-line customer-facing messaging + ETA to TICKET-5234 by Tue EOD. leadership needs something concise for partner and sales calls.

mira: will own pricing playbook + a midmarket price table. ETA: Tue COB.

devin: will own perf SLO proposal + fallback prototype note. ETA: Wed. will include bench links and a short appendix with real customer traces where allowed.

tara: will draft SLO packages + partner 1-pager. ETA: end of week.

alex: CS will publish top 7 asks + 3 sanitized loss postmortems with example prompts and quotes by Fri. will tag signals: security, latency, hallucination.

ben: I'll link evaluation suites into Redwood Optimize and add automated regression alerts for any rollout; please tag me on eval PRs.

jordan: Legal will outline the minimum private/VPC contract language and list certification milestones. ETA: next Tue.

deploy-bot: meeting notes uploaded: https://redwood.internal/notes/1802004567-ah-followup (access: redwood/all-hands). :spiral_note_pad:

sam: small tech asks: can Eng expose a beta flag for per-request token breakdown in Console? example toggle: `console.flags.token_breakdown=true`. this would unblock procurement demos.

devin: noted. will scope `telemetry.token_breakdown` behind a feature flag for beta customers; will include infra cost estimate in my write-up.

mira: one customer bought Dedicated because we provided an ops runbook + a 99th percentile SLA. we should have 2 sanitized win blurbs marketing can use. CS/Marketing: can you coordinate?

alex: yep, CS will hand sanitized quotes to Marketing once legal signs off.

sam: process ask: owners, if you hit blockers (legal/infra/finance) put a single-line blocker on the ticket so leadership can escalate.

natalie: scheduling a 30m office hour next Tue for cross-functional blockers. invite to owners incoming.

ci-bot: reminder in 48h: owners update TICKET-5234 with 1-line status.

sam: thanks all  concise and practical. closing thread; will circulate a 1-paragraph summary for partners after we get the ticket updates. :rocket:
